title: My FPS/RTT rogueliteish
author: Just-Routine967
selftext:
Been working on it for a little over a week. You start on the bridge of your flagship, with the objective of taking the main enemy hq, with various side objectives to take out like flak emplacements, supply depots. Between planets you can pick upgrades for your force.

You can command from the holotable on your ship, or join a drop pod wave, ride a troop transport or fly a strike craft down yourself.

Using binoculars from the planet you can watch drop pods or orbital rounds all the way from the ship to ground which tickles my tism.

All soldiers, ally and enemy are simulated map wide even if you can't see them so fronts can be pretty big.

100% vibecoded, workflow has been Fable or Opus overseers coordinating 4-5 other agents. Blender + Godot with C# running the sim side.
The soldier model was a Tripo attempt, not sure I like it.
